headline: Edwards Lifesciences (EW)’s TMTT Revenue Surges 47%: Can Rapid Growth Drive the Next Leg of Earnings Expansion?
summary: On July 23, Edwards Lifesciences Corporation (NYSE:EW) delivered second-quarter 2026 net sales of $1.74 billion, up 13.6% year over year (12.5% on a constant currency basis), surpassing Wall Street expectations of $1.70 billion.
